name: mod-collision-guard
description: Pauses an edit when another open session edited the same file moments ago, and asks whether to proceed, move to a worktree, cancel or say something else

enabled.title: Guard edits
enabled.description: Asks when another session edited it. Only edits inside the window count. Off, edits are still recorded for other sessions but never paused

window_minutes.title: Window (minutes)
window_minutes.description: How long an edit counts as recent. Only other sessions' edits count

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto picks Nerd Font or safe glyphs. It uses Nerd Font icons when Windows Terminal runs a Nerd Font, and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one
